verdict.rationale: First-party material describes in-product AI insights. Intuit Intelligence chat answers questions like "What's driving my profit?" with contextual answers, produces reports on top expenses, sales trends and industry benchmarking, and helps resolve anomalies. Payroll AI proactively spots inconsistencies, and the product offers funding suggestions and forecasting based on real-time financials. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing-level claims.
